Already in a Medicare Advantage plan? The Medicare Advantage Open Enrollment Period runs January 1 – March 31.

During this window, people enrolled in a Medicare Advantage plan can make one change. They can switch to a different Medicare Advantage plan, or return to Original Medicare and add a standalone Part D drug plan. The change takes effect the first of the following month.

This period is only for people who are already in a Medicare Advantage plan. It doesn't open a new chance to join one from Original Medicare. If your plan isn't working the way you expected this year, we can help you understand your options.

Honorbrook Insurance is an independent agency. We work for you, not for one insurance company.

Tap Call to talk with Luay.

We do not offer every plan available in your area. Any information we provide is limited to those plans we do offer. Please contact Medicare.gov or 1-800-MEDICARE to get information on all of your options.
